Project description 
 We are looking for the best people to help create the next big thing in digital banking.
 Reason to join us
 • We offer the opportunity to work in a highly professional environment where you will work with high-level financial instruments
 • We want you to be part of our success story and give you reasons to be proud of what you achieved as part of our fabulous team
 • We give you the opportunity to develop yourself and evolve in your career via our fantastic technical, business-related or soft skills training
 • We encourage creative-thinking in our great open-minded work environment. Frequently the relaxation rooms are the place where the most ambitions ideas are born.
 • We are not just professional teams, we are also friends who have fun working together
 • If you are an active person and you feel motivated by the creation/development of software solutions, then this is the place to be, you will not get bored.
 What is INMAP OCR
 • optical character recognition software which extracts data from scanned documents
 Responsibilities 
Troubleshoot and resolve software issues
Collaborate with Development team as needed to provide solutions
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to manage and maintain the application infrastructure, including policy configuration, profile deployment, software distribution and certificate installation
Provide Root Cause Analysis when requested
Monitor application health, security compliance, and performance, taking proactive measures to address any issues that arise
Deliver new and improved capabilities in systems monitoring, recovery and stability aspects of the system.
Assist in the setup and configuration of new platform infrastructure
Respond to and resolve escalated technical issues related to the application
Create and maintain documentation related to best practices and troubleshooting guides
Perform Application and DB script deployment
Other support-related activities
 Skills

Strong technical background with excellent problem solving and multi-tasking skills
Minimum 3 yrs or more of Technical / Application Support experience
Strong service oriented experience / background
Experience in IT Service Operations
Experience with SQL Server mandatory
Experience with Windows Powershell mandatory
Networking knowledge
Familiar with Incident Management processes and tools
Familiar with Agile methodology

Soft Skills:
Good communication skills
